title: Larkspur Closing Cost Credit Borrower Commitments: Repayment, Occupancy Certification and Own Funds
content:
The Larkspur Closing Cost Credit programs set three commitments on the borrower: whether the credit must be repaid on a sale or refinance, how many months the borrower certifies they will occupy the home, and the minimum funds the borrower puts toward the purchase from their own resources.

| Credit program | Repaid on sale or refinance | Occupancy certification (months) | Minimum borrower contribution from own resources (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit | no | 0 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Returning Customer Credit | no | 0 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur First Home Credit | no | 12 | 500.00 |
| Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee | no | 0 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Builder Partner Credit | no | 0 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant | no | 12 | 1000.00 |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant Plus | no | 12 | 1000.00 |

### Notes

- An occupancy certification of 0 months means the program carries no occupancy certification; three programs carry a twelve-month certification.
- No program in the schedule must be repaid when the home is sold or refinanced.
- The minimum borrower contribution is stated in US dollars; the Larkspur First Home Credit sets 500.00, both Neighborhood Access Grant programs set 1000.00, and the other programs set none.
